articles.text: NATO Cloud Deal And Mid‑Market AI Push Could Be A Game Changer For Accenture (ACN). In early July 2026, NATO’s Communications and Information Agency awarded Accenture a roughly €200 million, seven‑year Protected Business Network contract, delivered with Leonardo to modernize NATO’s secure multi‑cloud digital infrastructure for about 29,000 users. Accenture also announced new agentic AI solutions with Google Cloud for mid‑market clients, while sector‑wide worries about shifting IT and AI spending patterns have raised fresh questions about how consulting firms will evolve...

articles.text: Accenture (ACN) Curbs Routine AI Use As Token Costs Force Tighter Focus. Accenture has restricted employee use of generative AI for routine tasks to manage rising token costs. The company is shifting toward more targeted AI deployment, focusing on higher value internal and client use cases. This move reflects a broader reassessment across enterprises of how and where AI is applied in everyday workflows. For investors tracking NYSE:ACN, this AI usage reset comes as the stock trades around $138.52, with the share price down 18.7% over the past month and down 46.7%...
